text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some fan mail has arrived for Air Groove. I try to give it to her before our meeting, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: You're not happy to get fan mail?
You're not happy to get fan mail?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You fool. Why wouldn't I be happy?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But that's all the more reason I must temper my reactions.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: People don't wish to see me titter with appreciation. Their desire is to watch me preside as the Empress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The best way to repay my fans is to uphold that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's why I must remain disciplined as I go about my day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …I expect those who work with me to act accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Now then, shall we start the meeting?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the rest of the day, I sense that Air Groove behaves in an even more refined manner than usual.
